blocks.text: Nitrification aur denitrification nitrogen cycle ke do marhale (phases) hain. Nitrification mein ammonium (NH₄¹⁺) nitrite (NO₂¹⁻) aur nitrate (NO₃¹⁻) mein badalta hai, jab ke denitrification mein nitrate (NO₃¹⁻) wapas nitrogen (N₂) mein badalta hai. Ganday pani ki safai (wastewater treatment) mein nitrogen hatane ke liye bhi yahi do amal istemal hote hain. In ka farq Table 12.3 mein hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki ibarat kehti hai ke farq 'Table 12.2' mein hain, magar Table 12.2 nitrogen ke oxides ki table hai. Farq wali table Table 12.3 hai (neeche).

blocks.caption: Table 12.3 Nitrification aur denitrification mein farq
rows: Ammonia NH₃/NH₄⁺ nitrite (NO₂⁻) aur nitrate (NO₃⁻) mein badalta hai.
Nitrite (NO₂⁻) aur nitrate (NO₃⁻) wapas N₂ mein badalte hain, jo fiza mein chali jati hai.
Nitrifying bacteria, aerobic (oxygen wale) halaat, pH 6.5–8.0, behtareen temperature 20–30 °C.
Denitrifying bacteria, anaerobic (bina oxygen) halaat, pH 7.0–9.0, behtareen temperature 26–38 °C.
Paude yeh nitrites aur nitrates khurak ke liye jazb karte hain, kyun ke woh hawa ki nitrogen seedha istemal nahi kar sakte.
Wastewater treatment mein aham aur aabi jandaron (aquatic life) ke liye mufeed: NH₄⁺ ko NO₂⁻ se oxidise kar ke N₂ gas banana.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Nitrification mein nitrogen oxygen le rahi hai (oxidation): oxidation state NH₄⁺ mein -3 se NO₂⁻ mein +3 aur NO₃⁻ mein +5. Denitrification mein ulta hota hai (reduction): +5 se aakhir mein N₂ mein 0.

blocks.prompt: Nitrogen ki oxidation state ke lihaz se nitrification aur denitrification mein farq batayein (MCQ VI).
blocks.explanation: Nitrification oxidation hai: nitrogen -3 (NH₄⁺) se +3 (NO₂⁻) aur +5 (NO₃⁻) tak jati hai, aerobic bacteria ke zariye. Denitrification reduction hai: nitrogen +5 (NO₃⁻) se NO₂⁻, NO aur N₂O se guzar kar 0 (N₂) tak aati hai, anaerobic bacteria ke zariye.

blocks.prompt: a) Gari ke exhaust ke catalytic converter mein hone wale reduction aur oxidation reactions likhein.
blocks.explanation: Reduction: 2NO + 2CO → N₂ + 2CO₂ (Pt/Rh). Oxidation: 2CO + O₂ → 2CO₂ aur hydrocarbons ki oxidation, jaise 2C₂H₄ + 6O₂ → 4CO₂ + 4H₂O.

blocks.prompt: b) Catalytic converter ka bunyadi usool (basic principle) kya hai? Is mein catalyst ka kirdar batayein.
blocks.explanation: Garam exhaust gases honeycomb channels se guzarti hain jin ki alumina teh par Pt, Pd aur Rh ka bara surface area hota hai. Gases is surface par jazb (adsorb) ho kar jaldi react karti hain: NO ki reduction N₂ mein aur CO aur hydrocarbons ki oxidation CO₂ aur pani mein. Catalyst activation energy kam karta hai aur khud kharch nahi hota.

blocks.prompt: c) Kya hybrid aur electric cars mein catalytic converter hota hai? Kyun ya kyun nahi?
blocks.explanation: Hybrid car mein petrol engine bhi hota hai, jo exhaust gases nikalta hai, is liye us mein catalytic converter hota hai. Poori electric car mein engine nahi jalta, exhaust gas nahi nikalti, is liye us mein catalytic converter ki zaroorat nahi.

items: Nitrification (aerobic bacteria, pH 6.5–8.0, 20–30 °C): NH₄⁺ → NO₂⁻ → NO₃⁻, paudon ki khurak.
Denitrification (anaerobic bacteria, pH 7.0–9.0, 26–38 °C): NO₃⁻ → ... → N₂, nitrogen wapas hawa mein.
Dono wastewater treatment mein nitrogen hatane ke kaam aate hain.
